edges.reason: Both are in the workshop zone; mining the sign first orients the player to the adjacent fletching table 2 blocks away
Acacia planks must be crafted into sticks first, which are a required component for the arrow recipe (flint + stick + feather)
The prominent magenta terracotta wall at z:8 visually guides the player to the adjacent lime terracotta wall at z:9 for mining
Finding the terracotta structure on the left side orients the player to notice the sandstone corridor on the opposite right side
The tripwire is inside the fully enclosed sandstone corridor; mining through the front wall is the only way to enter and see it
The tripwire spans the corridor interior which is the only path to the donkey pen entrance at the corridor's far end
Iron leggings provide essential damage reduction against the enderman's 7-damage melee attacks during combat
Crafted arrows paired with the provided bow enable safe ranged engagement before the enderman closes to melee range

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining an oak_wall_sign drops it as 'oak_sign' item into the player's inventory. The sign is at ~2, ~1, ~3 and breaks instantly with any tool or bare hand. Player starts with 0 oak_sign items.
Uses inventory_has because mining a fletching_table drops it as an item into inventory. Located at ~4, ~1, ~3. Best mined with the stone_axe provided. Player starts with 0 fletching_table items.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to locate and observe the target. The magenta terracotta structure is at ~-7 to ~-4, ~1-3, ~8-10. Target center is [-6, 2, 9]. max_distance=6 forces actual navigation (spawn is ~9.6 blocks away, so player must walk closer). 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the terracotta wall.

Uses inventory_has because mining lime_terracotta with the stone_pickaxe drops it as an item. The lime terracotta wall is at ~-7 to ~-4, ~1-3, ~9. Player has stone_pickaxe which is required for terracotta to drop. Player starts with 0 lime_terracotta items.

Uses inventory_has because crafting acacia_planks (1 acacia_log → 4 planks in 2x2 grid) places them in inventory. min_count=1 to account for the player immediately converting some planks to sticks for arrow crafting before this milestone is evaluated. Player starts with 0 acacia_planks.

Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone with the stone_pickaxe drops it as an item. The sandstone corridor front wall is at ~5-10, ~1-3, ~7. Player must mine at least one block to create an entrance into the fully enclosed corridor. Player starts with 0 sandstone items.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require locating and observing the target. The tripwire is at ~6-9, ~1, ~10 inside the fully enclosed sandstone corridor (only accessible by mining through the front wall at z:7). max_distance=4 ensures the player is inside the corridor close to the nearly-invisible tripwire string. 60° facing tolerance confirms the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because crafting arrows (flint + stick + feather → 4 arrows on 3x3 grid) places them in inventory. Requires multi-step chain: logs→planks→sticks, then sticks+flint+feather→arrows. Player must place crafting_table for 3x3 grid. Player starts with 0 arrows.

Uses inventory_has because crafting iron_leggings (7 iron_ingots in leggings pattern on 3x3 grid) places them in inventory. Player starts with exactly 7 iron_ingots and 0 iron_leggings. Must use placed crafting_table for 3x3 grid access.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because hunting means killing the donkey — it should no longer exist. The donkey spawns at ~7, ~1, ~15 inside a fully fenced pen (x:5-10, z:13-16). Box [3,0,6] to [12,5,18] covers the pen and corridor area. The donkey cannot escape the fenced pen so this tighter box is safe. max_count=0 confirms the donkey is dead.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because combat means killing the enderman. It spawns at ~-5, ~1, ~16 without NoAI (can teleport when attacked, up to 32 blocks). Very generous box [-20,-5,-10] to [25,10,30] (45x15x40 blocks) ensures the enderman remains within detection range regardless of teleportation. max_count=0 confirms the enderman is dead.

scene_description: A compact multi-zone outpost with enforced spatial dependencies. Four zones radiate from spawn: (1) Workshop zone (near/forward) with oak wall sign and fletching table, (2) Terracotta structure (mid/left) with magenta and lime terracotta walls, (3) Fully enclosed sandstone corridor (mid-far/right) containing a tripwire trap and connecting to a fenced donkey pen, (4) Open enderman arena (far/left). The sandstone corridor is sealed on all sides with a ceiling, forcing the player to mine through the front wall to access the tripwire and donkey pen — this physically enforces the mine_sandstone→find_tripwire→hunt_donkey dependency chain.
task_text: Starting at the workshop, mine the oak wall sign and fletching table. Craft acacia planks from your acacia logs, then craft arrows using sticks, flint, and feathers. Find the magenta terracotta structure to the left and mine lime terracotta from it. Mine through the sandstone wall on the right to access the enclosed corridor — find the tripwire trap inside. Pass through to reach the donkey pen and hunt the donkey. Craft iron leggings for protection, then combat the enderman in the arena.
design_notes: LAYOUT: Player spawns at origin facing +Z (south). Ground layer: stone at y:-1, grass at y:0, air above. Workshop at (x:2-4, y:1, z:3-4). Terracotta L-shape at (x:-7 to -4, y:1-3, z:8-10). Sandstone corridor: front wall z:7, left wall x:5, right wall x:10, ceiling y:3, spanning z:7-12; interior hollowed x:6-9, y:1-2, z:8-12. Tripwire at z:10 inside corridor (hooks at x:6 facing east, x:9 facing west, string at x:7-8). Donkey pen: fenced rectangle x:5-10, z:13-16 with 2-block entrance at x:7-8, z:13 connecting to corridor exit. Enderman at x:-5, z:16 in open area. TOOLS: stone_axe (sign/fletching table), stone_pickaxe (terracotta/sandstone), stone_sword (melee), bow (ranged), crafting_table (3x3 grid). MATERIALS: 4 acacia_logs, 4 flint, 4 feathers, 7 iron_ingots. CRITICAL FIXES: (1) stone_pickaxe added for terracotta/sandstone drops, (2) corridor fully enclosed on all sides + ceiling, (3) NoAI removed from enderman for authentic combat.
